description: This file provides utility functions for managing environment variable mappings across different frameworks, based on YAML template files. It supports obtaining the template path, parsing the YAML config, applying prefixes, and mapping variables between common and framework-specific names.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the environment template file for a specified framework.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads a YAML template file and extracts an optional prefix and variable mapping dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Applies a prefix to all entries in a dictionary of environment variables.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a set of common environment variables into framework-specific variables using templates, applying direct mappings and prefix conventions.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts framework-specific environment variables back to the common format, reversing mappings and prefix-based transformations.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Lists all frameworks for which environment templates are available in the directory.

ctags.name: apply_prefix_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_common_to_framework
ctags.pattern: /^def map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_framework_to_common
ctags.pattern: /^def map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
